channel.title: Offshore North
channel.description:
No Canadian has ever finished the Vendée Globe — solo, non-stop, around the world, the Everest of the seas. Offshore North follows the campaign trying to change that, and the extraordinary sport around it: carbon boats that fly at highway speed, skippers who sleep in 20-minute fragments, races decided by seconds after weeks alone at sea. Every Monday: the Canadian campaign's week, the stories moving the wider fleet, and one thing explained properly — for lifelong sailors and for people who've never touched a rope. Sources in every episode. No hype, no jargon walls, no play-by-play.
AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.
